property_summary: For any admissible Collect call with unlockTime set to block.timestamp, the reference strictly requires block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime, so the call is a no-op and the caller's Acc balance is unchanged, whereas the mutant uses >= and executes the call, sending Ether out and decreasing the recorded balance.
change_summary: Changed the Collect unlock-time check from greater-than to greater-than-or-equal, altering when the external call and state update execute.
